BudgetedIV.ExtendedLimits.description: Raises limits like model info, handling, carcols and some pool sizes.
BudgetedIV.PedBudget.description: May cause issues; 0 keeps the game's.
BudgetedIV.VehicleBudget.description: Avoids the taxi bug, may cause vehicle audio issues; 0 keeps the game's.
CAMERASENSITIVITY.GamepadAimSensitivityR: Lowest and highest value of the sensitivity slider, separated by a comma.
CAMERASENSITIVITY.GamepadLookSensitivity: Lowest and highest value of the sensitivity slider, separated by a comma.
CAMERASENSITIVITY.MouseAimSensitivityRan: Lowest and highest value of the sensitivity slider, separated by a comma.
CAMERASENSITIVITY.MouseLookSensitivityRa: Lowest and highest value of the sensitivity slider, separated by a comma.
EPISODICCONTENT.EpisodicDeathMusic.descr: The restored death music in all episodes; needs sound files for each episode.
EPISODICCONTENT.EpisodicVehicles.descrip: APC, Buzzard, Smuggler, Floater, Blade and their abilities in IV and TLaD.
EPISODICCONTENT.EpisodicWeapons.descript: DSR1, grenade launcher, pipe bomb, sticky bomb, AA12 explosive shells, P90, parachute and their abilities in all episodes.
EPISODICCONTENT.ExplosiveAnnihilator.des: Explosive rounds of the Annihilator in IV; needs the episodic weapons.
EPISODICCONTENT.OtherEpisodicChecks.desc: Disco camera bobbing, phone switching, altimeter, explosive sniper and fists cheats in IV and TLaD; needs the episodic files.
Any episode's scripts can be used in all episodes.
EPISODICCONTENT.TBoGTHelicopterHeightLim: The helicopter height limit of TBoGT in IV and TLaD.
EPISODICCONTENT.TBoGTPoliceWeapons.descr: P90 and AA12 for SWAT and FIB, M249 for police in helicopters in IV and TLaD; needs the episodic weapons.
EXPERIMENTAL.DisplayMemoryStats.descript: With the FPS counter, shows memory counters like used streaming memory and the memory of the process.
EXPERIMENTAL.ReflectionMSAAQuality.descr: MSAA of the reflection maps like on the Xbox 360.
FOG.ExtendedTimecycEditing.description: Shows debug information and reloads the timecycle with F3.
FOG.VolFogFarClip.description: Far clip of the volumetric fog.
FOG.VolumetricFog.description: Fog lit by the sun and lights.
FRAMELIMIT.CutsceneFpsLimit.description: Frame rate limit in cutscenes, 0 for none.
FRAMELIMIT.DisplayFpsCounter.description: Shows the frame rate in a corner of the screen.
FRAMELIMIT.FpsLimit.description: Used when the FPS Limiter is Custom; negative values are relative to the refresh rate.
FRAMELIMIT.FpsLimitPreset.description: Limits the frame rate. Custom uses FpsLimit.
FRAMELIMIT.MinigamesFpsLimit.description: Frame rate limit in the minigames of the list.
FRAMELIMIT.MinigamesList.description: Scripts of the minigames, separated by commas.
FRAMELIMIT.UnlockFramerateDuringLoadscre: The game loads faster with the frame limiter on.
HDR.GameBrightnessNits.description: Brightness of the game's white and of the interface.
HDR.HDR.description: HDR output. Needs the Vulkan or DirectX 12 graphics API and Windows HDR, the menu offers it only then. On DirectX 12, fullscreen becomes a borderless window when HDR is turned on.
HDR.RollOffStart.description: Fraction of the peak brightness where highlights start to roll off instead of clipping.
LampHeadlVNS: Lampposts and Headlights + Vehicle Night Shadows
LANGUAGEOVERRIDE.Language.description: The language chosen in the game's menu, instead of the language of the installation.
MAIN.AimingZoomFix.description: How aiming zooms in TBoGT and in IV and TLaD.
MAIN.BlockOnLostFocus.description: Pauses the game while its window isn't active.
MAIN.CameraShake.description: The camera shakes at speed and with explosions.
MAIN.ConfineCursor.description: Keeps the mouse cursor inside the game window while the game is active, so it can't move to another monitor.
MAIN.Definition.description: Sharper image, the game's Definition option.
MAIN.GraphicsAPI.description: DirectX 9 is the game's own renderer. Vulkan (DXVK) is usually the fastest. DirectX 12 runs the game on D3D9On12 (a custom build). FusionFixHub installs DXVK and D3D9On12 on its Graphics enhancements page. If Vulkan or DirectX 12 fails to start, the next start uses DirectX 9.
MAIN.RecoilFix.description: Recoil with keyboard and mouse behaves like with a controller.
MAIN.SkipIntro.description: Skips the logos and the legal screen when the game starts.
MAIN.SkipMenu.description: Loads the last save when the game starts instead of showing the main menu.
MISC.ActionCamera.description: The cinematic camera when climbing fences and jacking cars.
MISC.AltDialogue.description: Alternative lines of dialogue cut from the game.
MISC.AlwaysDisplayHealthOnReticle.descri: Shows the health of people on the reticle with keyboard and mouse.
MISC.AlwaysRun.description: Runs without holding the sprint key.
MISC.AlwaysShowBulletTraces.description: Shows the traces of all bullets.
MISC.AmbientOcclusion.description: Shadows in corners and where objects meet.
MISC.Antialiasing.description: Anti-aliasing at native resolution. TAA needs d3dx9_43.dll; DLAA and FSR need Vulkan (DXVK) and their files from FusionFixHub's Graphics enhancements page. The menu offers only what can be used.
MISC.AutoClimbLadders.description: Climbs ladders when walking into them.
MISC.AutoClimbLaddersRange.description: How close the player must be to climb a ladder automatically; the button uses 4.0.
MISC.BrakeLightsWhenStopped.description: The player's brake lights are lit while stopped, like those of other vehicles.
MISC.Buttons.description: Button icons shown in the game.
MISC.CameraTurnSpeedKBInCar.description: Speed of the vehicle camera turning back, in steps.
MISC.CameraTurnSpeedPadInCar.description: Speed of the vehicle camera turning back, in steps.
MISC.CenteredFootCam.description: The camera on foot is centered behind the player.
MISC.CenteredVehCam.description: The vehicle camera is centered behind the vehicle.
MISC.ConsoleAutoExposure.description: Exposure adapts to light like on the consoles.
MISC.ConsoleCarReflectionsAndDirt.descri: Stronger car reflections, and cars can be dirty when they appear, like on the consoles.
MISC.ConsoleGamma.description: Contrast and colors like on the console versions.
MISC.DeathMusic.description: Plays the cut death music when the player dies in IV.
MISC.DefaultCameraAngleInTLaD.descriptio: The camera angle of IV on bikes in TLaD.
MISC.DelayBeforeCenteringCameraKB.descri: Delay before the camera centers behind the player on foot, in steps; 0 never centers.
MISC.DelayBeforeCenteringCameraKBInCar.d: Delay before the camera centers behind the vehicle, in steps; 0 never centers.
MISC.DelayBeforeCenteringCameraPad.descr: Delay before the camera centers behind the player on foot, in steps; 0 never centers.
Delay before the camera centers behind the vehicle, in steps; 0 never centers.
MISC.DepthOfField.description: Blur of distant and near objects, in cutscenes only or also while playing.
MISC.DisableCameraCenteringInCover.descr: No forced camera centering at the edge of a wall in cover.
MISC.DisableWardrobeTransition.descripti: No fade to black when changing clothes.
MISC.ExtendedSniperControls.description: More controls while aiming with a sniper rifle.
MISC.ExtraInfo.description: Extra information in the pause menu, like the number of loaded IMG files.
MISC.FieldOfView.description: Extra field of view, in steps.
MISC.InstantStopTaxi.description: Taxis stop at once when asked to.
MISC.LightSyncRGB.description: Lighting effects on Logitech LightSync devices.
MISC.MouseAimSensitivity.description: Mouse sensitivity while aiming, in steps.
MISC.NoBloomColorShift.description: Prevents color shifts of bloom with tone mapping on.
MISC.OverrideTreeAlpha.description: 0.625, 2.5 or 4.0 for the PC, PS3 or Xbox 360 tree alpha; 0 keeps the menu's choice.
MISC.PadAimSensitivity.description: Controller sensitivity while aiming, in steps.
MISC.PadLookSensitivity.description: Controller sensitivity of looking around, in steps.
MISC.PedDeathAnimFixFromTBoGT: Ped Death Animation Fix From TBoGT
MISC.PedDeathAnimFixFromTBoGT.descriptio: No extra death animation after counter attacks in IV and TLaD, like in TBoGT.
MISC.PlayerClimbRagdollControl.descripti: The reload key makes the player ragdoll while climbing.
MISC.PlayerJumpRagdollControl.descriptio: The reload key makes the player ragdoll while jumping, like in GTA V.
MISC.RawInput.description: Reads the mouse directly, without acceleration.
MISC.ScreenFilter.description: Color filter of the episode, or of another one.
MISC.SmoothShorelines.description: Smooth water edges and adjusted foam.
MISC.StuntJumpCamera.description: The cinematic camera of unique stunt jumps.
MISC.SunShafts.description: Rays of light around the sun.
MISC.TimedEvents.description: Snow in winter and pumpkins at Halloween, at their time of the year.
MISC.ToneMapping.description: Filmic tone mapping of bright colors.
MISC.TransparentMapMenu.description: Shows the game behind the map of the pause menu.
MISC.TreeAlpha.description: How the leaves of trees are cut out.
MISC.TurnIndicators.description: Vehicles of the player use their turn indicators.
MISC.ZoomedMovement.description: Allows moving while aiming with a zoomed weapon.
plugin.name: Fusion Fix
POSTFX.EnablePreAlphaDepth.description: Depth effects like depth of field and sun shafts are correct through windows and other transparent objects.
SHADOWFILTERCHSS.MaxSoftness.description: Largest shadow blur of the CHSS shadow filter.
SHADOWFILTERCHSS.ShadowBias.description: Shadow bias of the CHSS shadow filter; adjust to the smallest softness.
SHADOWFILTERCHSS.ShadowSoftness.descript: Smallest shadow blur of the CHSS shadow filter.
SHADOWFILTERSHARP.ShadowBias.description: Shadow bias of the Sharp shadow filter; adjust to the softness.
SHADOWFILTERSHARP.ShadowSoftness.descrip: Shadow blur of the Sharp shadow filter (like the Complete Edition).
SHADOWFILTERSOFT.ShadowBias.description: Shadow bias of the Soft shadow filter; adjust to the softness.
SHADOWFILTERSOFT.ShadowSoftness.descript: Shadow blur of the Soft shadow filter (like 1.0.4.0).
SHADOWS.CascadeBlendSize.description: Size of the blending region between shadow cascades.
SHADOWS.ExtraNightShadows.description: Rockstar's original night shadows of the PC version; broken, not recommended.
SHADOWS.HighResolutionShadows.descriptio: Doubles the resolution of the cascaded shadow map; very demanding.
SHADOWS.ShadowFilter.description: Sharp like the Complete Edition, soft like 1.0.4.0, or contact hardening.
SUNSHAFTS.SunShaftsDecay.description: How fast the rays fade from the center.
TEMPORAL.CameraCutDistance.description: Camera movement in one frame, in meters, that resets the history.
TEMPORAL.CurrentFrameWeightMax.descripti: Weight of the current frame in fast motion; higher reduces ghosting.
TEMPORAL.CurrentFrameWeightMin.descripti: Weight of the current frame when the image is still; lower is smoother and more stable.
TEMPORAL.CurrentFrameWeightPerPixelOfMot: Current Frame Weight Per Pixel Of Motion
How quickly the weight goes from min to max as motion increases.
TEMPORAL.D3D9on12Interop.description: Allows DLAA and FSR when the game runs on DirectX 12. Slow, not recommended.
TEMPORAL.DLSSPreset.description: DLAA model. DLAA needs NVIDIA DLSS from FusionFixHub's Graphics enhancements page.
TEMPORAL.FSRSharpness.description: FSR sharpening. FSR needs AMD FSR from FusionFixHub's Graphics enhancements page.
TEMPORAL.JitterPhases.description: Length of the sub-pixel camera jitter sequence; DLAA uses at least 32 and native-resolution FSR at least 8.
TEMPORAL.ObjectMotionVectors.description: Motion vectors for moving people, vehicles and objects.
TEMPORAL.SkinnedMotionVectors.descriptio: Motion vectors for animated limbs of people.
TEMPORAL.VarianceClipGamma.description: History rejection; lower reduces ghosting, higher reduces flickering.
TURNINDICATORS.LeftIndicatorKey.descript: The key of the left turn indicator, a virtual-key code (0xDB is [).
TURNINDICATORS.ManualTurnIndicators.desc: Turn indicators by hand: tap LB or RB on a controller, or the keys below.
TURNINDICATORS.RightIndicatorKey.descrip: The key of the right turn indicator, a virtual-key code (0xDD is ]).
UPDATE.CheckForUpdates.description: Off: Fusion Fix never goes online. On: when the game starts, it looks up the newest version at fusionfix.io and tells you in the game; FusionFixHub then opens its update page when you close the game.
USERPROFILE.CustomUserProfilePath.descri: A folder for saves and settings instead of the user's documents; empty for the default.
ff.plugins.description: A page per plugin with its preset and settings: {}.
ff.preset.description.plugin: Sets the settings of this plugin to Vanilla, Recommended or Enhanced.
ff.preset.enter: ~y~Press Enter to see what changes and apply the preset.
ff.preset.again: ~y~Press Enter again to apply the preset.
ff.confirm.title: Apply the {} preset?
ff.confirm.restart1: {} change takes effect after restarting the game.
ff.confirm.restart: {} changes take effect after restarting the game.
ff.confirm.none: The settings already match this preset.
ff.note.disabled.other: Not available with the current settings.
ff.note.mainmenu: Can only be changed in the main menu.
ff.note.upscaler: DLAA and FSR need the Vulkan graphics API (DXVK) and their files from FusionFixHub's Graphics enhancements page.
ff.note.restart: Takes effect after restarting the game.
ff.note.restarts: {} changes take effect after restarting the game.
ff.preset.description.own: Sets Fusion Fix's settings to Vanilla, Recommended or Enhanced. Its settings are on the game's tabs.
ff.update.hub: Fusion Fix {} is available. FusionFixHub opens when you close the game.
ff.update.site: Fusion Fix {} is available at fusionfix.io.
MISC.CutsceneBorders.description: Black bars in cutscenes: above and below (Letterbox), left and right on wide screens (Pillarbox), or both.
MAIN.WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a window with borders, or a borderless window that covers the screen. Alt+Enter switches between fullscreen and the last window mode.
ff.note.d3d9on12: Install D3D9On12 on FusionFixHub's Graphics enhancements page to enable DirectX 12.
DEBUG.SSRDebug.description: 1 to 10: reflection colour, ray hits, normals, horizon fade, specular, glass rays, contact shadows, indirect light, skin, its history (also Graphics > Debug)
DEBUG.GroundSurfacesDebug.description: 1: ground shaders in colours, and F10 logs how often each is used to GTAIV.EFLC.FusionFix.Ground.log (also Graphics > Debug)
DEBUG.WetGroundDebug.description: 1: material categories in colours | 2: wetness red, puddles green, rings blue (also Graphics > Debug)
DEBUG.CloudShadowsDebug.description: 1: the whole ground in cloud shadow | 2: the raw cloud noise (also Graphics > Debug)
DEBUG.VolumetricCloudsDebug.description: 1: grey at the matched sky brightness | 2 to 14: one term of the clouds' light in colours (also Graphics > Debug)
DEBUG.SSRMarchFullDepth.description: 1: SSR marches the full size depth instead of the half size one, to compare (also Graphics > Debug)
DEBUG.AerialPerspectiveDebug.description: 1: the air 25 times as thick, to see where the aerial perspective falls (also Graphics > Debug)
DEBUG.FrameGenerationDebugView.descripti: 1: a square, magenta on generated frames | 2: generated frames only | 3: both (also Graphics > Debug)
NIGHTSHADOWS.WorldLightShadows.descripti: Lights of the world get shadows the game gives them none of: lamps shadowed from their cache alone race for slots too (CachedLampShadows), lights of models (ModelLightShadows), coronas (CoronaLightShadows); each more light racing for the seven slots and the caches (restart)
DEBUG.GrassWindDebug.description: 1: the grass sways four times as hard, to see which plants take the wind (also Graphics > Debug)
PROJECT2DFX.CoronaRenderer.description: 1: Fusion Fix draws the coronas, less CPU time, skipping those out of view | 2: the same, none skipped | 0: the game draws them (restart)
DEBUG.DebugServerPort.description: A port (e.g. 5051): a debug server on 127.0.0.1 for reading game memory, patterns, the ini and logs from a tool (tools/gta4-live-mcp in the recomp) | 0: off (restart)
DEBUG.DebugServerAllowWrite.description: 1: the debug server may also write game memory and trace code (hooks, debug registers) (restart)
DEBUG.DeviceResetLog.description: 1: books every default pool resource, a failed device reset (fatal DD3D80) lists those still alive to GTAIV.EFLC.FusionFix.DeviceReset.log (restart)
DEBUG.EntityDrawLog.description: 1: draws of buildings, props, vehicles and peds and their CPU time per pass to GTAIV.EFLC.FusionFix.EntityClass.log every 600 frames
PERFORMANCE.LampShadowFaceCulling.descri: Lamps' dual paraboloid shadow maps get each building, prop and vehicle only in the half that faces it, some 40% fewer draws there | 0: both halves get them
PERFORMANCE.LampShadowRangeCulling.descr: Lamps' shadow maps leave out buildings, props and vehicles wholly beyond the lamp's light, which cannot shadow anything it lights | 0: all the game sends
PERFORMANCE.LampShadowSmallCull.descript: Lamps' shadow maps leave out props under 2% of their distance from the lamp (a 0.4 m can 20 m off), whose shadow is a few blurred texels | 0: all drawn
PERFORMANCE.LampShadowConeCulling.descri: Spot lamps' shadow maps leave out buildings, props and vehicles wholly outside the lamp's cone, which it does not light | 0: all the game sends
PERFORMANCE.LampShadowViewCulling.descri: Lamps' shadow maps leave out buildings, props and vehicles that cannot shadow anything the camera sees (outside the hull of the view and the lamp) | 0: all the game sends
PERFORMANCE.SkipLeftOutDraws.description: The passes left out above (reflections and far cascades taking turns, the night's cascades) skip the game's CPU work for their objects too | 0: only their GPU draws go
PERFORMANCE.FarPropInstancing.descriptio: Grass, weeds, small plants and the ground's litter, rocks and rubble past 30 m are drawn with one instanced draw per model instead of one each, and no longer thin out past 60 m | 1: plants only | 0: one draw each, thinned
DEBUG.FarPropInstancingLog.description: 1: Far Prop Instancing: instances, groups, instanced draws and fallbacks per pass to GTAIV.EFLC.FusionFix.FarPropInstancing.log every 600 frames
MISC.FirstPersonOnFoot.description: The change camera control goes on from the farthest view on foot to first person (restart)
MISC.FirstPersonInVehicle.description: The change camera control goes on from the hood view in a vehicle to first person (restart)
PERFORMANCE.UnpinMainThread.description: The main game thread may run on any CPU core, not only the first one the game pins it to (restart)
DEBUG.UpscalerTimingLog.description: 1: CPU time of the DLSS / FSR and frame generation exchange to GTAIV.EFLC.FusionFix.Upscaler.log
DEBUG.FrameGenerationDebug.description: Logs, bits | 2: where the generated frames fall (slow) | 8: pacing
ANTIALIASING.FrameGenerationPacing.descr: Where in the next frame the rendered frame goes | 0: by the CPU's clock | 1: by the draw calls | 2: by GPU timestamps
ANTIALIASING.FrameGenerationDeferred.des: 1: the generated frame is made while the next one renders, the GPU does not wait for it | 0: the game's Present shows it
ANTIALIASING.FrameGenerationAsyncCompute: 1: frame generation runs on a compute queue beside the game's next frame | 0: after the game's work
ANTIALIASING.HelperPresent.description: With DLAA or FSR the helper shows the frames, the generated ones too (windowed or borderless, not under Wine) | 1: frame generation paced by AMD's swap chain | 2: by the helper's own (FrameGenerationDelay)
PROCEDURAL.GpuGrassHideProps.description: With GPU Grass on, the game's grass, weed and small plant props are not made where it grows (nor drawn), coming back as it thins out with distance | 0: both
PROCEDURAL.GpuGrassClumps.description: Clumps of GPU grass per piece of ground (up to 1.5 square metres), 8 to 160: the cost goes with their number
PROCEDURAL.GpuGrassCrossed.description: Each clump a cross of two cards, full from every side, twice the cost of a flat one (40 crossed cost what 80 flat do) | 0: a flat card
DEBUG.GpuGrassLog.description: 1: GPU grass: ground triangles, pieces and blades drawn per frame to GTAIV.EFLC.FusionFix.GpuGrass.log every 600 frames
PROCEDURAL.GrassWind.description: The wind sways the grass, weeds and small plants, harder in a strong wind | 0: they stand still
PROCEDURAL.GrassBending.description: Grass bends under feet, wheels and a helicopter's downwash | 0: it doesn't
PROCEDURAL.GrassTrample.description: Grass walked or driven over stays down and rises again over a few seconds | 0: it rises at once
PROCEDURAL.BushShake.description: Bushes part away from people and cars going through them and shake while they move | 0: they don't
DEBUG.GrassWindLog.description: 1: the wind, grass draws per pass and the grass models' heights to GTAIV.EFLC.FusionFix.GrassWind.log every 600 frames
PERFORMANCE.HiZOcclusion.description: Occlusion culling: buildings, props, cars and people hidden behind the depth drawn, two frames running, are left out of the scene (their shadows and reflections stay); log in GTAIV.EFLC.FusionFix.Occlusion.log | 2: tested and counted only | 0: off; not 0 at the start, it changes on the fly
PERFORMANCE.LampShadowsOcclusion.descrip: A lamp or headlight whose whole reach is hidden behind buildings draws no shadow map, its slot goes to a light in view | 0: off
PERFORMANCE.CoronasOcclusion.description: Lamp coronas and distant lights hidden behind buildings get no quad (they were invisible already, only CPU work goes); log in GTAIV.EFLC.FusionFix.Occlusion.log | 2: counted only | 0: off
PERFORMANCE.HiZOcclusionBoxes.descriptio: Buildings are tested by their model's box as they stand, cars, people and objects by their sphere | 0: all by the sphere
DEBUG.PostFxProfiler.description: 1: GPU time of each effect and of the game's passes to GTAIV.EFLC.FusionFix.PostFx.log every 120 frames
PROCEDURAL.ProceduralInReflections.descr: 1: props in water reflections too, as the game has them | 0: left out
PROCEDURAL.ProceduralGatherPriority.desc: With the ground triangles nearly all taken, the far ones go first, so near ground keeps its props
PROCEDURAL.ProceduralFarThinning.descrip: Past the game's own reach props thin out with distance, each at its own reach, instead of all going as far as Grass & Props Distance takes them | 0: all go the whole way
PROCEDURAL.ProceduralSmallFarCull.descri: Props smaller than 0.5% of their distance (a weed past 180 m) are not drawn, and past 60 m small ones thin out, 60 / distance of them kept, the same ones each time: thousands of far weeds cost up to 3.5 ms of CPU | 0: all drawn to their reach
PERFORMANCE.HeavyPropCull.description: Small objects made of many parts (benches, posts, stands: 8+ draws each) leave the sun's shadows past 40 m and thin out past 80 m, none past 100x their radius: up to 2 ms of CPU | 0: all drawn
PERFORMANCE.FarFadeCull.description: Small buildings and props (lamp posts, traffic lights, plants) the game is fading out far off leave somewhere in the faint half of their fade instead of at its end, each at its own point: Detail Quality draws them 100+ m past their own reach as a faint stipple at a full draw's price | 0: to the end of the fade
PROCEDURAL.ProceduralConeRelease.descrip: Props left well behind the camera go and come back when you turn to them | 0: they stay until their ground goes
PROCEDURAL.ProceduralGroundCovers.descri: Grass that runs on under a road or a pavement grows no plants or GPU grass blades up through it (nor props on it) | 0: as the game has it
DEBUG.ProceduralLog.description: 1: the generator's time and limits to GTAIV.EFLC.FusionFix.Procedural.log every 30 s | 2: every event too (restart)
DEBUG.Profiler.description: Samples a second (e.g. 500) of the busiest threads: where each is and what called it; every ProfilerInterval s their CPU time and busiest functions to GTAIV.EFLC.FusionFix.Profiler.log, every call stack of the session to Profiler.folded (flame graphs); each sample stops a thread for an instant, at 1000 it took 10-20% of a core; the debug server (cpu_profile) runs it on its own when off | 0: off (restart)
DEBUG.ProfilerThreads.description: How many of the busiest threads are sampled (the main thread always), 1 to 32
DEBUG.ProfilerSpikeMs.description: A frame of the main thread longer than this gets its own block in the log: where the main thread was and what the two busiest threads did meanwhile | 0: off
PERFORMANCE.SunShadowsAtNight.descriptio: 1: the sun's cascaded shadows are drawn at night too | 0: not from 22:00 to 05:00, which saves some 7 ms a frame at night
PERFORMANCE.ReflectionsHalfRate.descript: The water's reflection and the cars' reflection map are drawn every other frame while the camera hardly moves | 0: every frame
PERFORMANCE.WaterReflectionWhenSeen.desc: The water's reflection is not drawn while no water was seen on screen a frame or two before (the game draws it with water behind the houses too) | 0: whenever the game draws it
PERFORMANCE.FarCascadesHalfRate.descript: The two far sun shadow cascades take turns, one drawn a frame, while the camera keeps still | 0: every frame
PERFORMANCE.MidCascadeHalfRate.descripti: The second cascade (10 to 30 m out) takes turns too; passing cars may show their shadows a frame late | 0: every frame
DEBUG.RenderSkipTrace.description: 1: two frames of the game's passes to GTAIV.EFLC.FusionFix.RenderSkip.log, 20 s into the game (restart)
DEBUG.CascadeMatrixTrace.description: 1: 300 frames of the sun cascades' matrices to GTAIV.EFLC.FusionFix.RenderSkip.log, 20 s into the game (restart)
LIGHTING.SkyHDR.description: The sky passes the game's brightness clamp without the volumetric fog too, so the sun blooms | 0: as the game
DEBUG.SkyTrace.description: 1: the sky dome's draws (textures, sampler states, cloud parameters) to GTAIV.EFLC.FusionFix.SkyTrace.log, each change as it happens; Ctrl+Shift+F6 saves the sky as the game drew it (before fog and post effects) to GTAIV.EFLC.FusionFix.SkyCapture<n>_<call>.dds
ANTIALIASING.CurrentFrameWeightPerPixelO: Current Frame Weight Per Pixel Of Motion
ANTIALIASING.ObjectMotionVectors.descrip: Motion vectors for moving peds, vehicles and objects
ANTIALIASING.DLSSPreset.description: DLAA model: 0 default | 10 J | 11 K | 12 L | 13 M (needs nvngx_dlss.dll in the game or plugins folder)
ANTIALIASING.RainAfterAntialiasing.descr: The rain is added after TAA, DLAA and FSR, so its streaks are not smeared
ANTIALIASING.SkinnedMotionVectors.descri: Motion vectors for the animated limbs of peds (restart)
ANTIALIASING.ReactiveMask.description: TAA and FSR: particles and glass follow the current frame more, less ghosting on them (restart)
ANTIALIASING.SteadyDepth.description: Depth of field, sun shafts and coronas read a depth steadied over the jitter, so their edges do not flicker (restart)
PERFORMANCE.WaterFarLayer.description: The far part of the water's reflection (past 400 m: most of a river's city) is drawn only now and then (every 2 s, or once the camera moved 10 m or turned 2 degrees) into a layer of its own and laid in from it every frame; turning, its edge shows sky until the next | 0: all of it every time
NIGHTSHADOWS.CachedLampShadows.descripti: With Building Light Shadows: lamps the game shadows from its cache compete for slots too | 0: they keep their cached shadow (restart)
NIGHTSHADOWS.ModelLightShadows.descripti: With Building Light Shadows: lights of models made without shadows get them | 1: all of them | 2: buildings' only (shop fronts, signs on a facade) | 3: objects' only (scaffold and tunnel ceiling lights, wall lamps) | 0: none; each more light racing for the slots and caches (restart)
NIGHTSHADOWS.CoronaLightShadows.descript: With Building Light Shadows: a lamp that is only a glow lights its surroundings, with a shadow, in its colour (restart)
NIGHTSHADOWS.CoronaLightApproximation.de: 1: a glow without an authored range and intensity gets them from its size | 0: no light for it (restart)
NIGHTSHADOWS.ModelLightShadowsNeedCaster: Such a light competes for a slot only with a car or ped in its light | 0: always (restart)
NIGHTSHADOWS.ModelLightCacheDistance.des: Such a light within this many metres of you also gets a cached map, baked from cube faces, whose edges stay straight (an awning under a shop front's light no longer shadows with a round hole); cars and peds still draw over it | 0: never (restart)
NIGHTSHADOWS.LampCacheBudget.description: Lights that cast a shadow without a cached map of their own (the game's lamps with a dynamic shadow only, tunnel and room lamps, model lights): the nearest this many within the lamp shadow reach get one, baked from cube faces, the ones you look at first; their slot then draws only cars and peds over it | 0: only model lights within ModelLightCacheDistance (restart)
NIGHTSHADOWS.LampShadowCaches.descriptio: Cached lamp shadow maps (static world and props, a lamp keeps its shadow without a slot) | 8: the game's | 16: the shadow atlas 5 x 5 maps instead of 4 x 4 | 32: in the same atlas, 12 whole maps and 20 at half size for far lamps (restart)
NIGHTSHADOWS.CacheWholeTileDistance.desc: With 32 caches: a lamp nearer than this many metres (behind the camera counting three times as far) takes a whole map, a farther one a half-size one (restart)
NIGHTSHADOWS.CacheEvictMargin.descriptio: With 32 caches: a lamp's cache goes to another lamp only when it is this many times as far (plus 2 m), so lamps at about the same distance stop handing caches back and forth (restart)
NIGHTSHADOWS.PropsInLampCaches.descripti: A cached lamp shadow map holds the props the lamp lights (scaffolds, awnings, bins), so their shadows stay while the lamp has no slot; they take no capsule or box shadow from it then (restart)
NIGHTSHADOWS.LampsSkipOwnObject.descript: A light of an object (a scaffold's ceiling light, a lamp post's head) leaves that object out of its own shadow map: a light hanging inside its object went dark below whenever it took a slot | 0: drawn (restart)
NIGHTSHADOWS.SharedMaps.description: Two lights written at the same place share one shadow map | 0: a slot each (restart)
NIGHTSHADOWS.LampShadowsInDaylight.descr: 1: lamps cast shadows whenever the game lights them | 0: not while the sun's shadows are drawn outside
NIGHTSHADOWS.CloseHeadlightRelevance.des: Headlights shining right at you count when the slots are given out
NIGHTSHADOWS.TrafficSelfShadowFix.descri: Oncoming traffic casts no shadow from its own headlights while you are on foot
NIGHTSHADOWS.NearbyVehicleReceivers.desc: On foot, headlights lighting a car near you cast shadows even when you are outside the beam
NIGHTSHADOWS.LampViewPriority.descriptio: Lamps whose light reaches the view come first, keeping the game's own choices and shadow caches
NIGHTSHADOWS.LampShadowAxis.description: Which way a lamp's two-half shadow map looks; where its halves' rims are, shadows come out fat and bent | 0: the game's, every map split across world x | 1: down for lamps, along the beam for spots (walls beside a lamp on the rims) | 2: lamps level toward you (down when you are under one), spots along the beam: you, your car, its shadow and the street toward you near a half's centre
NIGHTSHADOWS.LampShadowPlaneDepth.descri: A lamp's shadow map takes each texel's depth on the drawn surface along its own ray, not between the corners of a big triangle, which bent walls and awnings near a lamp (a wall shadowing itself, holes in an awning's shadow, a tunnel road's curved bands); any LampShadowAxis
NIGHTSHADOWS.VisibleReceiverRanking.desc: A lamp whose light reaches the view ranks up to 1.15 times nearer in the game's own sort, the more the nearer the middle of the frame (Liberty's Shadows 2.0.1)
NIGHTSHADOWS.LampCacheViewPriority.descr: The eight cached lamp shadows go first to lamps you look at, not to the nearest ones behind you: lamps down the street have their shadows before you come near
NIGHTSHADOWS.CasterAwarePriority.descrip: The slots go first to lights with a car or ped you look at in their light; while driving, the lamps ahead
NIGHTSHADOWS.InteriorLightsFirst.descrip: On foot inside, the lamps of the interior you are in take the night shadow slots before the lights outside (Liberty's Shadows 2.1.0)
NIGHTSHADOWS.AddedLightsLast.description: Traffic signals and building lights (windows, shop fronts, neon) take a shadow slot only when no other light wants it; meanwhile cars, people and props under them cast box and capsule shadows
DEBUG.NightShadowsCrashDiagnostics.descr: 1: crash context of the night shadows to GTAIV-shadow-crash-*.bin (restart)
DEBUG.NightShadowsDiagnostics.descriptio: 1: night shadow diagnostics and a light trace to GTAIV.EFLC.FusionFix.NightShadows.log (restart)
HEADLIGHTS.ConsistentBrightness.descript: Headlights of the car you just left keep the player's brightness and range while they stay on (restart)
HEADLIGHTS.LightModes.description: The headlight control steps through on, high beams and off (restart)
HEADLIGHTS.OffscreenLights.description: A car's lights go out out of view where nothing else sees it, beyond 35 m | 0: as the game | 1: your car | 2: every car (restart)
NIGHTSHADOWS.OwnHeadlightCasterFix.descr: Your car and the people in it cast no shadow from its own headlights (restart)
NIGHTSHADOWS.CameraAwarePriority.descrip: Lights whose light reaches the view come first (restart)
DEBUG.NightShadowsSlotLog.description: 1: who takes the seven night shadow slots and why, to GTAIV.EFLC.FusionFix.NightShadows.SlotTrace.log (restart)
DEBUG.NightShadowsCacheLog.description: 1: what the eight static lamp shadow caches do (new entries, evictions, lamps waiting for one) to GTAIV.EFLC.FusionFix.NightShadows.CacheLog.log (restart)
NIGHTSHADOWS.LampsBehindWalls.descriptio: A lamp without a cached shadow behind a wall (the next tunnel) gives its slot to lamps you can see (restart)
NIGHTSHADOWS.SlotAllocation.description: Who gets the seven night shadow slots | 0: the game | 1: worked out and logged, not used | 2: Fusion Fix, with slots kept for the player (restart)
NIGHTSHADOWS.TrafficSignalShadows.descri: Traffic signals nearest you that cast shadows, sharing the seven slots | 0: none | up to 7 (restart)
NIGHTSHADOWS.EmergencyLightShadows.descr: The flashing lights of up to two emergency vehicles within 30 m cast shadows (restart)
NIGHTSHADOWS.LampShadowRetention.descrip: A far lamp at the edge of its shadow's reach keeps the shadow a moment longer, so it does not flicker on and off (Liberty's Shadows 2.0.4) (restart)
NIGHTSHADOWS.LampShadowFade.description: A far lamp's shadow fades out over the last part of its reach instead of going at once (Liberty's Shadows 2.0.4) (restart)
NIGHTSHADOWS.IndoorShadowBubble.descript: On foot, the lamps of the room around you within 10 m keep their shadows however small they look (Liberty's Shadows 2.0.4) (restart)
NIGHTSHADOWS.StableMapSlots.description: A light keeps its place in the shadow atlas while it keeps its slot | 0: the game renumbers them every frame (restart)
NIGHTSHADOWS.PostShadowsFromCarLights.de: Street and park lamp posts cast shadows in the light of car headlights and rear lamps (restart)

Headlights and other car lights shadow nearby cars as boxes too
1: lamps with a slot draw the cars into their map and keep the boxes under it | 0: their map leaves the boxed cars out
NIGHTSHADOWS.VehicleBoxShadowsUntilLeavi: A car keeps the shadow it got from a lamp, the map's or the box, until it leaves the lamp | 0: they swap as the lamp gains and loses its slot
NIGHTSHADOWS.VehicleBoxShadowsBlend.desc: Box shadows, shadow maps and contact shadows take the darkest of them, not their product
NIGHTSHADOWS.VehicleBoxShadowsLive.descr: 1: boxes follow each car as its lights are drawn (can jerk) | 0: as handed over, moved ahead by the car's speed
DEBUG.VehicleBoxShadowsLog.description: 1: the box shadows of the car nearest you to GTAIV.EFLC.FusionFix.VehicleBoxShadows.log
NIGHTSHADOWS.PropShapeShadows.descriptio: With box shadows: lamp posts, bins, benches, containers and other props cast the shadow of a capsule or a box from the lights near them, car lights too
NIGHTSHADOWS.VehicleBoxShadowsLowLightNa: Vehicle Box Shadows Low Light Narrow
NIGHTSHADOWS.VehicleBoxShadowsLowLightHe: Vehicle Box Shadows Low Light Height
REFLECTIONS.SSRPastThinObjects.descripti: 1: a ray passing behind a thin object such as a trunk carries on | 0: it ends as a miss
REFLECTIONS.SSRStepJitter.description: Ray steps are offset per pixel, turning bands into fine noise | 0: the same for every pixel
REFLECTIONS.SSRTemporalJitter.descriptio: The step offsets change every frame and the accumulation averages them | 0: the same every frame
WEATHER.VolumetricCloudsWeather.descript: The clouds follow the weather: ragged heaps when fair, a low dark deck in rain | 0: one fixed cloud layer
WEATHER.PbrSkyHorizonHue.description: 1: the Physical Sky takes the timecycle's hue down to the horizon (its evening brown) | 0: near the horizon the air's own
REFLECTIONS.CloudReflections.description: The volumetric clouds in the water's reflection too | 0: the game's sky there
PERFORMANCE.CloudReflectionsAtNight.desc: 1: volumetric clouds in reflections at night too, when they show nothing | 0: the game's sky then, some 2.5 ms saved
PERFORMANCE.CloudReflectionsHalfResoluti: The clouds in reflections are worked out at half size | 0: at the reflection's size
PERFORMANCE.CloudsHalfResolution.descrip: The volumetric clouds are worked out at half size and built up over frames | 0: full size, sharper, about four times their cost (restart)
REFLECTIONS.SSRGBufferNormals.descriptio: 1: reflect off the normals the game stores | 0: rebuilt from depth, coarse on cars and roads
LIGHTING.ContactShadowsMoon.description: The moon's contact shadows at night while the sun's cascades are off (SunShadowsAtNight 0)
LIGHTING.ContactShadowsStepJitter.descri: Contact shadow steps are offset per pixel, turning bands into fine noise | 0: the same for every pixel
LIGHTING.LocalContactShadows.description: Street lights and headlights cast contact shadows too (with Contact Shadows and Extra Night Shadows at its last setting)
LIGHTING.FillLights.description: 1: the large exterior lights that flood squares and building fronts stay | 0: darkened
LIGHTING.FarLights.description: 1: map and traffic lights shine from farther: they fade from 350 m at least, light the view from out of it within 100 m (the game 35 m), traffic signals keep their lights to 200 m (the game 80 m) (restart)
REFLECTIONS.SSRCarWindows.description: Car windows reflect the scene around them
REFLECTIONS.SSRCarWindowsStepJitter.desc: Car window ray steps are offset per pixel | 0: the same for every pixel, edges show as slices
POSTFX.AmbientOcclusionGTAOMultiBounce.d: 1: light surfaces darken less in their corners, as they bounce light into them | 0: occlusion alone
PERFORMANCE.ContactShadowsHalfResolution: Contact shadows are worked out at half size, about a quarter of the cost | 0: full size (restart)
1: headlight shafts take the headlight's shadow, which hides them (restart)
